# Audited exceptions for the personal-data invariant (scripts/lib/repo_invariants.py).
# Generic accounts, CI/cloud users and placeholder domains are built in. One entry per line;
# an unknown directive is an error, and everything else in this file is scanned like any file.
#   home <name>             a directory name that is not a person (matched case-insensitively)
#   email <user@host.tld>   one exact address, or  email @host.tld  for every address on a host
#   file <path-or-glob>     a public use of the maintainer's name (author field, contributor line,
#                           byline); only the identity-token check is skipped for the file
file .claude-plugin/marketplace.json
file site/brute/index.html
file graphify-out/graph.json
file .planning/reports/MILESTONE_SUMMARY-v0.25.0.md
